body:
PRE TRIPPING
It started off like any typical Saturday morning for my boyfriend and me. I worked at the ski hill during the day from 8-4 and he would snowboard. We woke up, ate breakfast and went to our car. The car began to overheat as we drove down the highway and I realized that I would not be going into work today.
We turned the car around and drove back home before we got stranded in -30 weather in the middle of a twisty, turny highway with semis barreling past us at lighting fast speeds and HUGE mountains, nobody would be able to help us for hours! I was not down to freeze waiting for a tow truck that probably wouldnt come and get us until Monday.
This already put me into a glorious mood as I didnt have to work all day waiting tables at the ski hill and it gave me time to get ready for the rave that we were going to be headed to later on that evening. At around 4 pm my boyfriend went to go see if the car would cooperate for us so we can drive to the next town over to be able to attend the rave. However, luck was not on our side and the car was not cooperating whatsoever. Living outside of a small town, there were no busses running unless they were shuttles or greyhounds that took people from mountain to mountain for days of shredding and cab rides from town to town ranged 150-250 dollars which we could not afford! Being a ski bum is hard! We began to brainstorm ideas of how we can get there to meet my boyfriends friend, S who was at a hotel with some dudes she just met who were also attending the rave.
I came up with our only solution and that solution was to hitchhike. We quickly scarfed down dinner and ran out to the highway at around 6 pm after smoking some pot. We walked down the highway heading towards our destination, holding our thumbs out laughing and freezing, doing dances for the cars that passed us by, making fun of all the fancy cars and rich folk who would stare at us like we were both crazy for hitchhiking at night in -15 weather. There wasnt a cloud in the sky and the sunset made the snow on the mountains pink and orange, such a brilliant display. After about 45 minutes we began to lose hope as less and less cars were driving by now and nobody seemed to want to pick us up. We agreed we would try 3 more cars  semi trucks and expensive Dodges not included  and on the 3rd car a small silver Jetta pulled over with 3 gnarly dudes that were headed to our destination! Was this fate?? I think so. The universe was totally working with us on that one.
It was a quiet ride and the guys were total stoners and super friendly! Gotta love the pot community always helping each other out. They dropped us off right in front of Ss hotel and refused to accept our offerings of cash and took off. We went into Ss hotel room and met C, M and J (who we actually called The Fish Boy all night, we forgot his name). C was a nice guy who was really laid back and down to earth, M was much the same, just super chillin and cool, both guys were talking about Shambhala and how awesome it was this past year, I too attended Sham and it is awesome, I recommend it to anyone who loves festivals.
DROPPING THE LSD
Everyone was drinking beers and such before heading out for dinner and drinks at the bar. L went into the bathroom to drop the acid and left it under the garbage can for me to take after him. I drank some beers with the guys and S, so she wouldnt suspect anything and make a big deal (L lived with her once for 6 months and she would always freak out when she found out he was smoking weed or doing anything drug related). I decided to take 2 tabs because I felt confident I could handle it.
After I came out of the bathroom we went to go walk to the restaurant only to find that it was closed. We then walked to another restaurant and L and I began to come up on the LSD, laughing and admiring the stars on our walk. I imagined aliens watching over us and other civilizations watching earth twinkle as I watched their solar systems and planets twinkle and dance in the navy sky.
As we walked into this bar, a bald guy began talking to us by the name of Pops and he was super eccentric and happy. He shook our hands and only seemed interested in L and me. I began getting feelings of paranoia/anxiety that maybe he was a cop or security guard and he could tell that L and I were high. Then he asked us where we are living and he told us to mention his name at the local bar downtown near where we live and that we would get discounts on drinks and food! AWESOME! This guy totally wasnt a narc. We sat down only to find that this pub didnt serve food and we left and went to the next pub. The walls began to slowly start breathing and my galaxy print pants started to move and twist with all the colors, I imagined that they were a portal into outer space, the thought made me smile.
We stopped in the gas station to get some grape flavoured cigars to smoke for our trip.
We finally get to the restaurant and we really start to notice the effects hitting us. Music sounded so melodic and ironically all the music playing in the pub was 60s and 70s drug culture music. I ordered a baileys hot chocolate and scarfed it down in minutes, it was sooooo delicious. I never tasted anything so divine in my life. I ordered another one and drained it down equally as fast. My boyfriend and I started getting super anxious, wanting to get to the rave so we could take our MDMA and candy flip. Plus we couldnt stop dancing in our seats and I could no longer focus on the conversation happening at our table and was more intrigued by the patterns dancing on the walls and the way my boyfriends floral print Hawaiian shirt was so brilliantly dancing to the beat of the music. I decided I wanted to go have a smoke outside and L came with. We stood outside, laughing and talking, looking at the stars and I got an overpowering sense of oneness with the universe, I felt so deeply connected to every person who walked by and I couldnt help smiling and saying hello to every person who walked by, I wanted to give everyone this euphoric feeling I was experiencing.
I couldnt help smiling and saying hello to every person who walked by, I wanted to give everyone this euphoric feeling I was experiencing.
We went back into the restaurant and when we looked at the clock, we couldnt even fathom how SLOW time was going. Minutes felt like hours as we waited for everyone to finish their drinks and food.
After everyone had their drinks, we headed back to the hotel for more drinking but L and I decided that we wouldnt drink anymore as too much alcohol may ruin the effects of the LSD or make for a bad trip.
We found a cab that took us to the lodge of where the rave would be at. The LSD made me super hot and I couldnt even feel the stinging cold of -25 weather. I was excited to finally get to coat check and take off my jacket so I could dance. I admired everyones outfits and felt like I was in a 70s painting as everything was still continuing to sway from side to side. We finally made it past coat check into the rave where everyone went to go stand in line for more drinks. L and I chilled with our group and chatted with them about the rave and our favourite DJs and watching all the different people, some getting kicked out already for being too mangled or selling drugs.
DOING THE MOLLY/PARTYING IT UP
Everyone got their drinks and headed to the dance floor and I decided to go to the bathroom. It was downstairs in the basement of the venue and I was extremely frightened. I walked into the ladies washroom and it reminded me of prostitution and sex, it made me feel extremely negative feelings and I could hear a voice in my head saying, You worthless skank, get back up there and drink. Who comes to a party and doesnt drink? Look at you; youre a mess just like the rest of them. Nobody likes you. I agreed with the voice and said yes, agreeing with it, maybe I am worthless, maybe everyone does hate me but I looked at myself in the mirror and as the voice began to tell me that I was ugly, I silenced it, telling it I hated it and that it isnt real but that it's merely a figment of my imagination and that I refuse to give into it. I waited for a few moments to make sure it wouldnt return and it didnt! I defeated my ego; I defeated the mindless mind noise. I focused again, on what was around me and what I was originally doing: Peeing.
The bathroom made me think of how dark the world is as I saw some girls puking and wobbling about, barely clothed, make up heavily done. It made me sad to see these girls do this to themselves by drinking too much and not knowing their limits. I could tell some of them were having very dark/bad trips just as I had almost gotten sucked into a moment ago, as they stood in front of the mirror staring at themselves, walking around like they have no soul or life inside of them anymore, avoiding looking at anyone. I looked at the floor and walked as fast as I could to the nearest, cleanest empty stall as most of them were disgusting. I sat down and peed as fast as I could but the pee wouldnt stop. I mustve been holding it for a long time. I decided to take out my water bottle and dump some MDMA in it. The floor looked like bubbling, brown, mud and was so dirty. I needed to get out of there ASAP or I might start to have a bad trip again. I quickly washed my hands and ran up the stairs to the dance floor.
I handed my boyfriend his pill and we shared the M water. We started dancing and the music possessed my body. Both of us twisted and dancing to the music, perfectly to the beat.
We started dancing with this group of people we saw at the pub we were at earlier and did some more M to keep us going. My boyfriend decided to go find S as she seemed to not be enjoying herself much, as fish boy kept running off without her and M and C found ladies to dance with.
We decided to go to the loft part of the lodge to escape the now overcrowded dance floor. We got up there and L noticed a guy with a majestic beard sitting at the bar alone. L went up to compliment his beard and this man started telling us the most hilarious and crazy stories about his various trips on LSD he had when he was younger and partying. S began to get visibly bored of listening to this man talk and she told me she could hardly understand him and she thought he was creepy and weird. She and I began to dance and just chat about random things but I could see L laughing and talking to this man I wanted to listen to more of his stories. S finally announced that she wanted to go back downstairs to the guys and L and I went with her.
L and I began dancing and starting to trance out to the lights and music. Looking only at each other and dancing while the music twisted and moved our bodies in various positions. We started laughing and the dance floor started getting even more crowded than before and we went upstairs again after S took off on her own. The MDMA was definitely present in our systems now as lights seemed even more bright and intense and all we could do was smile and laugh. I had intense feelings of euphoria thinking about how lucky we are to live in the mountains and how happy I am to have such an amazing and supportive group of friends and family. How lucky I am to have such an amazing boyfriend and how happy I am we are partying at this rave. We went outside to admire the stars and the bearded man appeared again, who is named G. He reminded me of Jesus and L said that he actually thought that this man is Jesus because he began talking to us about aliens, life and the universe, telling us more crazy stories! We were watching the mountain being groomed and G told us that it looks like the bottom of the ocean which blew Ls mind and my mind, I stared at it, wondering if outer space really is just an ocean and other planets and stars are simply particles floating in the ocean. We went back inside and met a rad girl, Ma and she was so funny and adorable. We chatted with G and Ma for a long time and S called for us to come back down as she lost the boys again.
We went back downstairs and I lost L in the crowd. When I lost him I went outside for a smoke. These two scary old ladies dressed up in crazy tutus and wearing a unicorn horn started talking to me, lighting my smoke for me. I chatted with them for a bit but I began to lose interest as these old ladies started slurring their words and not making much sense. L found me and they began harassing him, petting his hat and lighting his smoke for him.
L was leaning on the balcony looking at the stars and I joined him, we were both filled with wonder and awe at what else could be out there. What else is looking back at us right now, wondering who we are.
We went back inside and continued with our shenanigans and found the bearded man again! He told us a few more hilarious stories and then he took us over to Ma
. The rave was ending now and it was time to head back to the hotel.  We found S, C, M and Fish boy (J) and went to get in line for coat check. I was being squished by everyone pushing to get through and after 25 minutes L and I finally got our jackets only to find that S, C, M and Fish boy were long gone on the first shuttle bus. We waited for the next bus outside, sweating balls while everyone else complained about the freezing cold. Finally the bus came and L and I realized we didnt have a ticket to get back to the hotel! All of a sudden Ju and Ma appear and they have 2 extra tickets! What a coincidence! Thanks again, Universe!!! We both felt like little kids on a field trip, yelling and laughing with all the people. We get off at the first stop and realize we got off at the wrong hotel. Ma and Ju invited us to hang at their room but L wasnt feeling it. He wanted to go back and party with M and C.
We walked back to the right hotel and admired the views around us. It was a nice walk, very quiet and tranquil and we kept finding ourselves walking in the middle of the road. Laughing and talking. Good thing they were no cars. We went back to the hotel and sat in the lobby for a while just talking about the night and how much fun we all had. We decided that the bricks of the lobby desk looked like trapped souls trying to escape. We started noticing skulls and scary faces in everything and decided we should go back to the room. We started walking down the hallway and it looked like it was stretching longer and longer as we walked and we started feeling weird heat waves hitting us as the hallway danced and twisted
we started feeling weird heat waves hitting us as the hallway danced and twisted
. We finally made it to the room only to find that everyone was in bed, drunk and passed out. L and I were wide awake and we had to sleep on the floor with one pillow and a blanket to share. We spent the next 4 hours thinking about waffles and breakfast and listening to music and writing notes to each other, trying to figure out how we can kiss quietly but soon gave up in a fit of giggles. We slept for half an hour and then we woke up before everyone else and went to get breakfast.
The LSD was still very present in our system as the floor looked like it was bubbling lava and food tasted AMAZINGLY delicious but I got full very fast only eating half of my waffles and an orange. S, M, C and Fish Boy came into the breakfast room and ate, scarfing down their food as fast as humanly possible and then all of us walked back to the hotel to pack, relax and chat a bit.
Check out was 11:30 and L and I got dressed and decided to leave at 10:30 to be able to get a head start hitchhiking back. We walked for a long time, admiring how bright and sunny it was. We felt like we had been walking for hours and hours and realized only an hour and a half elapsed, we began to lose hope. We had frost in our hair and I started worrying that nobody was going to pick us up. We got desperate thumbing to anyone who drove by  cabs, busses, semis. Finally we noticed a Semi pulled over and rolled to a stop. We couldnt believe our eyes. We eagerly ran to the semi and the guy was totally rad!
When we got to our destination we exchanged facebooks and tromped down to our cabin.
We got inside and sat in front of a cozy fire, relaxing and enjoying the last few remnants of LSD inside us after smoking a bowl of marijuana! After supper we plugged in some adventure time and fell asleep.
This experience taught me a lot about myself, revealing some of my fears, but mostly helping me realize how much I love life, how lucky I am and how much I still have to learn. LSD and MDMA are extremely therapeutic to me and always have taught me to be happy and confident in my choices. This trip lasted 14 hours and it was worth it, every second.
[Reported Dose: ''2 Tabs LSD 100 mg MDMA'']
